I don't like things suspended in custard.  Put the same stuff on a table separately and I'm good.  Trifle is like cutting up a steak and some broccoli and stirring it into mashed potatoes.It is practically a desert casserole.

Now bananas and custard on the other hand, really does require suspension in custard. And it's delicious.
